scope: Caller investigation only; not a package fix, release clearance, or blanket disposition of every OS finding.

assessments.affected_condition: GNU extension __gnu_pbds binary_heap erase_if uses storage that was freed; this is not ordinary std::priority_queue.
assessments.service_assessment: No pb_ds include, __gnu_pbds identifier, or binary_heap_tag in the 41,666 scanned exact consumer/build files. No __gnu_pbds symbol in the complete image ELF probes.
assessments.remaining: Header code can be inlined and symbols stripped. Exact source/build closure for every installed OS C++ consumer was not acquired. Do not apply the application-source exclusion to all OS packages or future tooling.

assessments.affected_condition: GNU parallel search header algorithm compares beyond the pattern buffer; requires GNU parallel mode or explicit GNU parallel search instantiation.
assessments.service_assessment: No _GLIBCXX_PARALLEL, __gnu_parallel, or parallel/search or algorithm includes in the scanned exact consumer/build files. Only the library __gnu_parallel Settings functions are visible in image probes, not an application search instantiation.
assessments.remaining: Inlined header code cannot be excluded for every OS binary by symbol absence. Missing exact OS-source/build provenance remains. A newer shared runtime alone does not fix an embedded header instantiation.

assessments.affected_condition: Certain vector<bool> size/range constructors call _S_nword with a count near SIZE_MAX (or invalid negative range), wrapping word-count addition. The patch targets constructors, not every vector<bool> operation.
assessments.service_assessment: Node: Maglev constructor count is BasicBlock::Id uint32_t, far below SIZE_MAX on these amd64 images. Wasm constructor count is tags.size() of an existing std::vector<WasmTag>; valid existing container size is bounded below the overflow region. Other service V8 vectors use default construction then checked resize/push_back. Skia vector<bool> implementations use libc++ std::__1, not affected GCC header. libheif uses a 3-bit HEVC layer count or an existing component container length; service HEIF input is separately blocked.
assessments.remaining: Do not infer architecture-independent safety from uint32_t: on a 32-bit target that count alone would not exclude near-SIZE_MAX. Exact OS consumer constructor/build closure is incomplete. No generic 5 MB input-bound waiver is used.

assessments.affected_condition: GCC floating-point from_chars implementation pattern() may read beyond [first,last) on specific non-NUL-terminated tokens. Integral from_chars and other libraries own implementations are outside this patch.
assessments.service_assessment: Complete /usr,/app,/bin,/sbin,/lib,/lib64 ELF probes have zero imported from_chars symbols. All defined affected GCC floating APIs occur only in the two installed shared-libstdc++ payload hashes. Node definitions are integer std::from_chars or independent fast_float/simdjson routines; exact source direct std calls are integral. Skia JSON float fallback is libc++ or strtof, consistent with payload std::__1 implementation and absence of GCC floating imports.
assessments.remaining: The vulnerable library bytes remain installed. This is a bound-image caller exclusion, not a patched-package claim; future plugins, new PInvoke/dlsym bindings, rebuilt consumers or changed library payloads require reassessment. No source-wide dynamic symbol-loading proof for arbitrary operator-added code is claimed.

assessments.affected_condition: Repeated byte-at-a-time filebuf writes after induced write failures leave the put pointer advancing, permitting a buffer overflow. Ordinary ostream operations set error state and prevent repeated output.
assessments.service_assessment: Imports exist in Node, Sharp addon, apt libraries and ICU toolutil. Exact Node heap-profiler FileOutputStream uses os_.write and close; report/snapshot/debug paths use ordinary ostream/ofstream operations. Sharp service path processes buffer input/output; source search shows no direct sputc retry loop. Red Hat explicitly distinguishes standard stream operations from the affected pattern.
assessments.remaining: Do not use Red Hat RHEL-system-utilities statement as proof for Debian/Ubuntu apt or ICU. Every direct/custom filebuf retry caller and supported tools command needs source review, or a fixed libstdc++ package. Imported filebuf/vtables are evidence of actual API use and cannot be dismissed.

assessments.affected_condition: Aligned operator new rounds a huge size/alignment into a small allocation in C11 aligned_alloc, Wine, or fallback implementations. Upstream explicitly identifies posix_memalign implementation as unaffected.
assessments.service_assessment: Exact extracted libstdc++ from API/web/tools amd64 images disassembles aligned operator new directly calling posix_memalign@plt. No vulnerable round-up occurs on that compiled branch. The inspected throwing scalar aligned-new entrypoint selects this branch; the source branch contains no size round-up.
assessments.remaining: Scope is the exact host libstdc++ payload hashes in libstdcpp-binding.json. Other-architecture packaged Skia assets are not running against this amd64 library and are not independently cleared by this finding. Rebind any rebuilt image to these library hashes.
